description: This file defines the MidiDispatcher class, which extends MidiReceiver and manages dispatching MIDI messages to a list of MidiReceiver instances. It provides methods for connecting/disconnecting receivers, counting receivers, and handling message sending and flushing.
external_methods: MidiReceiver.send(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiDispatcher
classes.description: A utility class that manages multiple MidiReceiver instances and dispatches MIDI data to them.

methods.name: getReceiverCount
methods.description: Returns the number of MidiReceiver objects currently registered.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Provides a MidiSender object for managing the connection of MidiReceivers.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver's onSend method to dispatch MIDI messages to all registered receivers, removing any that throw an IOException.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver's flush method to flush all registered receivers.
